_comment: Tier-2 for febio::growth_remodeling#2. Two runs of the same growing block: constrained on three symmetry planes, J equals the growth multiplier cubed (computed by the fixture from the load curve, not quoted) and the stress stays at round-off; every outer node clamped, J stays at exactly 1, nothing moves, and the residual stress exceeds a tenth of the elastic modulus. Both reach normal termination with exit 0, all steps completed, no ERROR and no WARNING — there is no divergence to warn you, which is the whole claim. Executed 2026-08-06 on FEBio 4.12.0.86045466d (source build, USE_MKL=OFF). MUTATION CONTROL (2026-08-07): T2_MUTATE=1 neutralises the L.swap / L.drop edits this fixture uses to turn a correct deck into a broken one, so every deck it builds is the correct one and the pitfall is never triggered. Unmutated the fixture still PASSES; mutated it FAILS because the expectation 'clamped_growth=reproduced' is no longer printed and the forbidden token 'not_reproduced' appears. Re-verify with `cd <fixture dir> && T2_MUTATE=1 ~/Schreibtisch/open-fem-agent/.venv/bin/python source.py` (the mutation branch lives in source.py, so the proof is one command and needs no external harness).
